This workshop lasts 2 hours and is split into the following sessions, ,
which will be covered in order:

- [Introduction to the workshop](/sessions/introduction.qmd)
- [Shiny apps](/sessions/shinyapps.qmd)
- [Introduction to golem](/sessions/golem.qmd)
- [Building our app](/sessions/build_app.qmd)
- [Concluding remarks](/sessions/conclusion.qmd)

## Learning outcome and objectives

The overall aim of this workshop is to enable you to:

1.  Understand how a shiny app works and how you build it
2.  Show you how to modularize it
3.  Teach you how you can improve performance of loading- and processing
    times
4.  Make interactive plots that respond to user input

Broken down into specific objectives for each session, the workshop has
been designed to enable you to do the following:

[**Shiny apps**](/sessions/session.qmd)

{{< include /includes/objectives/_shinyapps.qmd >}}

[**Golem**](/sessions/session.qmd)

{{< include /includes/objectives/_golem.qmd >}}

[**Building our app**](/sessions/session.qmd)

{{< include /includes/objectives/_build_app.qmd >}}

Tangibly, during the workshop you will:

- Learn about the role of the UI and the server

- Create a modularized app with the golem package

- Learn about the parquet data format and duckplyr

- Build a plotly graph using the `penguins` dataset

- Make graphs interactive using plotly
